stemMarkdown: The average of 8 numbers is 24. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 9 numbers divided by 9. If the new number added is 149, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 8 numbers $= 8 \times 24 = 192$. New sum $= 192 + 149 = 341$. New average $= \dfrac{341}{9} = 37.89$.
